supplements.title: Rabdosin B suppresses proliferation of nonsmall cell lung cancer by regulating the SRC/PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Rabdosin B, a compound from a Chinese herb, stops lung cancer cell growth by blocking a specific cellular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Low, plasma level‑informed native curcumin concentrations fail to induce cell death in human lung and colorectal cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Curcumin from turmeric at realistic blood levels fails to kill lung and colorectal cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Mechanistic insights into the roles of astragalosides and Astragalus polysaccharides in gynecological and breast cancers (Review).
supplements.summary: Astragalus compounds show promise as adjuvant therapy for breast, ovarian, and cervical cancers by suppressing tumor growth and enhancing immune response.

supplements.title: Lifelong vitamin B12 monitoring after gastrectomy: A case report of subacute combined degeneration with 8-year latency in an alcoholic.
supplements.summary: Doctors should monitor vitamin B12 levels for life after stomach removal surgery, especially in patients who drink alcohol heavily.

supplements.title: Integrative network pharmacology and in vitro validation reveal the mechanisms by which Apigenin reverses MET-TKI resistance in non-small cell lung cancer.
supplements.summary: Apigenin helps overcome drug resistance in lung cancer by reversing resistance to MET-targeted therapies.

supplements.title: Enhanced antitumor activity of atorvastatin and luteolin, with or without doxorubicin, in a solid Ehrlich carcinoma mouse model: modulation of ABC transporters, telomerase, and cancer stem cells.
supplements.summary: Atorvastatin and luteolin combination therapy effectively reduced solid Ehrlich carcinoma tumors by targeting chemoresistance mechanisms.

supplements.title: Exploring the role of metabolic disorders and gut microbiome in immune checkpoint regulation in cancer: PI3K/AKT/mTOR focus.
supplements.summary: Metabolic disorders and unhealthy gut bacteria weaken immune defenses against cancer by suppressing anti-tumor immunity through inflammatory pathways.

supplements.title: Trigonelline suppresses the tumor progression via STAT2 signalling pathway in non-Small cell lung carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Trigonelline, a natural compound, kills lung cancer cells by blocking growth and triggering cell death through the STAT2 pathway.

supplements.title: Effectiveness of exercise interventions in patients with colorectal cancer during adjuvant chemotherapy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Exercise during chemotherapy helps colorectal cancer patients maintain physical function and quality of life better than standard care alone.

supplements.title: Pedunculoside Inhibits Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression by Activating the MAPK Signaling Pathway Through Targeting and Suppressing CDK4.
supplements.summary: Pedunculoside, a natural compound, slows liver cancer by blocking CDK4 protein, stopping cancer cell growth and triggering cell death.

supplements.title: Engineered E. coli Nissle 1917 Depletes Branched-Chain Amino Acids to Suppress Colorectal Tumorigenesis.
supplements.summary: Engineered bacteria that deplete branched-chain amino acids in the gut significantly suppress colorectal cancer growth in mice.

supplements.title: Deguelin inhibits perineural invasion in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma via targeting BDNF/TrkB axis.
supplements.summary: A natural compound called deguelin blocks nerve invasion in esophageal cancer by targeting a specific growth pathway.

supplements.title: Tumor-suppressing efficacy of essential oil of Boswellia serrata gum resin and its synergistic effect on doxorubicin-induced growth inhibition of breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Boswellia serrata essential oil kills breast cancer cells and boosts doxorubicin effectiveness, suggesting potential as complementary cancer therapy.

supplements.title: Theranekron modulates extracellular matrix and apoptotic signaling pathways in colorectal cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Theranekron extract kills colorectal cancer cells by activating apoptosis and restoring healthy extracellular matrix balance through multiple signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Gut microbe-derived N-acyl serinol lipids shape host postprandial metabolic homeostasis.
supplements.summary: Gut bacteria produce lipids that regulate how the body processes food and manages metabolism after meals.

off_label.title: Enhanced antitumor activity of atorvastatin and luteolin, with or without doxorubicin, in a solid Ehrlich carcinoma mouse model: modulation of ABC transporters, telomerase, and cancer stem cells.
off_label.summary: Atorvastatin and luteolin combination therapy effectively reduced solid Ehrlich carcinoma tumors by targeting chemoresistance mechanisms.

off_label.title: Second-generation prokineticin PKR1 receptor agonists: Advancing cardioprotection against chemotherapy-induced toxicity.
off_label.summary: A new drug called IS39 protects the heart from damage caused by doxorubicin chemotherapy in cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Alterations in the testicular lipidome after tumor irradiation and their potential modulation by long-term losartan treatment.
off_label.summary: Losartan treatment may help protect testicular function and fertility in cancer patients receiving radiation therapy by reducing radiation-induced lipid damage.

off_label.title: Endoscopic application of tranexamic acid and sucralfate in upper gastrointestinal bleeding: A randomized controlled trial.
off_label.summary: Applying tranexamic acid and sucralfate directly to bleeding sites during endoscopy reduces rebleeding in difficult upper gastrointestinal cases.

off_label.title: Ultrasound-Responsive Dual-Prodrug Nanoassembly for 'Fenestrae-Restoration Strategy' in Liver Fibrosis Therapy.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed ultrasound-activated nanoparticles that restore liver blood vessel openings, allowing anti-fibrosis drugs to reach and stop liver scarring progression.

off_label.title: Immunometabolism in lung cancer - The link between metabolism and immune response.
off_label.summary: Lung cancer tumors reprogram their metabolism to suppress immune responses, offering new therapeutic targets to restore anti-tumor immunity.

off_label.title: Metformin in gastrointestinal cancers and inflammatory bowel disease: Unraveling its mechanisms and therapeutic applications.
off_label.summary: Metformin shows promise in treating gastrointestinal cancers like colorectal, esophageal, and gastric cancers through the AMPK/mTOR pathway.

off_label.title: Machine learning-driven identification of shared and disease-specific mitochondria-related genes in COPD, NSCLC, and NSCLC with COPD.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified mitochondrial gene signatures in blood that accurately diagnose NSCLC and COPD separately and when they coexist, revealing potential drug targets.

off_label.title: CCT3-mediated regulation of XPO1/RB1 axis stability promotes cellular senescence and tumor progression in clear cell renal carcinoma.
off_label.summary: CCT3 protein drives kidney cancer growth by stabilizing XPO1, which exports tumor suppressors, blocking cellular senescence and enabling progression.

off_label.title: Beneficial Effects of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2 Inhibitors in Cisplatin Nephrotoxicity: A Mechanistic Review.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors may protect kidneys from cisplatin chemotherapy damage without reducing cancer-fighting effectiveness, according to preclinical research.

off_label.title: RAGE Inhibition Reduces Surgery-Induced Cerebral Edema After Glioma Resection.
off_label.summary: Blocking a protein called RAGE reduces brain swelling after glioma surgery in mice, offering a potential alternative to steroids.

off_label.title: Trabectedin decreases myeloid resistance to improve the efficacy of anti-PD1 immunotherapy and delay glioma malignant progression.
off_label.summary: Trabectedin reduces immune-suppressing cells in brain tumors, enhancing immunotherapy effectiveness and extending survival in gliomas.

off_label.title: Teriflunomide modulates the PD-1/PD-L1 axis and enhances antitumor immunity in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: Teriflunomide, an existing multiple sclerosis drug, reduces colorectal cancer growth by blocking immune checkpoint signals and boosting immune cell activity.

off_label.title: Inhibition of MAPK p38α overcomes the cancer immunosurveillance defect caused by FPR1 loss-of-function mutation.
off_label.summary: Blocking MAPK p38α restores immune cell function and prevents accelerated colorectal cancer in mice with FPR1 defects.

off_label.title: A Phase II Randomized Open-Label Trial of Levetiracetam for Prevention of Seizures in Patients With Brain Metastases in Primary Motor Cortex
off_label.summary: A trial tests whether the drug levetiracetam prevents seizures in patients with brain cancer metastases in the motor cortex.

biomarkers.title: Rabdosin B suppresses proliferation of nonsmall cell lung cancer by regulating the SRC/PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Rabdosin B, a compound from a Chinese herb, stops lung cancer cell growth by blocking a specific cellular signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: Low, plasma level‑informed native curcumin concentrations fail to induce cell death in human lung and colorectal cancer cells.
biomarkers.summary: Curcumin from turmeric at realistic blood levels fails to kill lung and colorectal cancer cells in laboratory tests.

biomarkers.title: Mechanistic insights into the roles of astragalosides and Astragalus polysaccharides in gynecological and breast cancers (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Astragalus compounds show promise as adjuvant therapy for breast, ovarian, and cervical cancers by suppressing tumor growth and enhancing immune response.

biomarkers.title: Crosstalk between KRAS and miRNAs in pancreatic cancer: Opportunities for its diagnosis, prognosis and therapeutic intervention (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Pancreatic cancer research shows miRNAs could improve diagnosis and treatment by targeting the frequently mutated KRAS gene that drives tumor growth.

biomarkers.title: CALYPSO: Final Results of Savolitinib and Durvalumab Combination in Metastatic Papillary Renal Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A drug combination of savolitinib and durvalumab showed promising results in treating metastatic papillary kidney cancer.

biomarkers.title: Preoperative gastric cancer immune prognostic score (GCIPS) as a novel biomarker for predicting survival in gastric cancer patients after radical resection: A retrospective cohort study.
biomarkers.summary: A blood-based immune score predicts survival outcomes in gastric cancer patients after surgery, enabling better risk stratification.

biomarkers.title: Renal cell carcinoma presenting with orbital metastasis as the initial symptom: A case report.
biomarkers.summary: A rare case showed that renal cell carcinoma can first appear as an eye tumor before other symptoms develop.

biomarkers.title: PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors in recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking PD-1/PD-L1 immune checkpoint inhibitors improves treatment outcomes for recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal cancer.

biomarkers.title: Genetic evidence for a causal protective effect of GLP-1 receptor agonists on paralytic ileus but not on other gastrointestinal events.
biomarkers.summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists genetically reduce paralytic ileus risk but show no causal link to other gastrointestinal disorders.

biomarkers.title: Beneficial subgroups for PD-1 inhibitor plus chemotherapy in first-line treatment of advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
biomarkers.summary: PD-1 inhibitors combined with chemotherapy improve survival in advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, particularly in high PD-1-expressing tumors.

biomarkers.title: Frequency of hyperlactatemia in craniotomy and its association with anesthesia: A prospective observational study.
biomarkers.summary: High lactate levels occurred in 60% of brain tumor surgery patients, correlating with tumor aggressiveness rather than anesthesia type.

biomarkers.title: A Metal-Free Carbon Monoxide Prodrug Suppresses Metastasis of Pancreatic and Breast Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A new carbon monoxide drug reduces metastatic spread in pancreatic and breast cancers by targeting a specific protein pathway.

biomarkers.title: ETV4 Promotes Colorectal Cancer Progression by Reprogramming Asparagine Metabolism to Remodel the Stromal Microenvironment.
biomarkers.summary: ETV4 protein drives colorectal cancer spread by altering asparagine metabolism, which activates immune cells that fuel tumor growth and metastasis.

biomarkers.title: Association between antibiotic exposure and the risk of checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis in lung cancer patients.
biomarkers.summary: Antibiotic use may increase the risk of serious lung inflammation in lung cancer patients receiving immunotherapy drugs.

biomarkers.title: Towards personalised screening for lung cancer: a sex-stratified approach in a Danish cohort integrating pre-diagnostic systemic inflammatory indexes with smoking status and age.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers propose sex-specific lung cancer screening using blood inflammation markers alongside smoking history and age to better identify at-risk women.

trials.title: CALYPSO: Final Results of Savolitinib and Durvalumab Combination in Metastatic Papillary Renal Cancer.
trials.summary: A drug combination of savolitinib and durvalumab showed promising results in treating metastatic papillary kidney cancer.

trials.summary: A blood-based immune score predicts survival outcomes in gastric cancer patients after surgery, enabling better risk stratification.

trials.summary: Blocking PD-1/PD-L1 immune checkpoint inhibitors improves treatment outcomes for recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal cancer.

trials.summary: PD-1 inhibitors combined with chemotherapy improve survival in advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, particularly in high PD-1-expressing tumors.

trials.title: TLR9-activating cholesterol azetidine derivative-assisted therapeutic vaccines for cancer immunotherapy.
trials.summary: A new nanovaccine using cholesterol compounds activates immune cells to fight melanoma and HPV tumors, especially when combined with immunotherapy.

trials.title: Transcriptional readthrough precedes alternative splicing programs triggered in CML cells by imatinib.
trials.summary: Imatinib drug treatment triggers early transcriptional readthrough in CML cells, leading to abnormal gene fusion transcripts before standard gene expression changes occur.

trials.title: Patterns of opioid dose escalation in patients with chronic kidney disease initiated on opioids for the treatment of non-cancer pain.
trials.summary: Patients with kidney disease who start opioids for pain often need increasing doses, raising safety concerns in this vulnerable group.

trials.title: A nationwide survey on the prevalence of asbestos-related lung cancer in Japan.
trials.summary: A Japanese survey found that 2% of primary lung cancers are asbestos-related, affecting mostly men with advanced disease who may qualify for compensation.

trials.title: Co-expression of IL15 promotes effector differentiation and sustained proliferative capacity in ALPPL2-specific human CAR T cells.
trials.summary: IL15 co-expression enhances CAR T cell survival, proliferation, and tumor-killing capacity against ALPPL2-positive cancers.

trials.title: Chemoradiation Reprograms Tumor Cells and the Immune Microenvironment in Cervical Cancer.
trials.summary: Combining MDM2 inhibitor with chemoradiation improves treatment response in cervical cancer by reshaping immune cells.

trials.title: MRI-based AI framework for predicting lymph node metastasis and prognosis in rectal cancer after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy: a multicenter study.
trials.summary: AI analysis of MRI scans predicts lymph node spread in rectal cancer patients after chemotherapy and radiation treatment.

trials.title: Site-specific limitations of ctDNA in PDAC surveillance: imaging detects pulmonary and local recurrence missed by liquid biopsy.
trials.summary: Imaging detected lung and local pancreatic cancer recurrence that blood tests missed in pancreatic cancer patients.

trials.title: CT-based radiomics signature for optimizing adjuvant chemotherapy decisions in stage II colorectal cancer with proficient mismatch repair.
trials.summary: Researchers created a CT scan analysis tool to predict which stage II colorectal cancer patients need chemotherapy after surgery.
